sources.title: As An AI Language Model Meme: Origin and Meaning Explained
sources.snippet: As An AI Language Model is a catchphrase disclaimer that ChatGPT uses when declining to answer certain questions. The phrase became a meme in 2023 when people discovered it appearing in spam content, fake reviews, and plagiarized writing across the internet, revealing the widespread use of AI-generated text.
